correctness.rationale: For a prime ideal \(P\), adjacency in \(GT_P(R)\) is \(\bar y=-\bar x\) in \(R/P\). Hence the graph is \(qK_s\) in quotient characteristic two and \(K_s\sqcup((q-1)/2)K_{s,s}\) in odd quotient characteristic. An isolated \(K_1\) occurs exactly when \(s=1\). For \(s\ge2\), each component needs exactly two vertices for total domination and each minimum pair is an edge, so paired domination has the same minimum. The stated counts multiply the exact componentwise counts.

value.rationale: This gives a complete exact strengthened-domination classification for a standard ring graph family already studied for ordinary domination. It identifies the exact existence obstruction, separates quotient characteristic two from odd characteristic, proves equality of total and paired domination throughout the nontrivial regime, and enumerates every minimum witness.
